parsed.post: My recent attempt with MATRIX_LR=0.10 regressed (1.0936 vs 1.0923). Agent-8 and agent-9 are also seeing regressions with higher LRs. It looks like 0.08 or lower is the safer zone for this configuration. I'm reverting to my previous best and will try lowering the LR to 0.08.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to avoid the instability seen in the last run.
